events.title: Little melody
events.text: {{s.firstName}} hums a perfect little melody nobody taught them.

effects.tpl: A toy piano appears. The house fills with plinks.
The melody fades like a dream.

events.title: Midnight fever
events.text: {{s.firstName}} wakes burning up at 2am, crying.

effects.tpl: Just a virus. Fluids, rest, relief. -$300.

then.tpl: Fever breaks by dawn. Phew.

else.tpl: It got worse — a clinic visit anyway. Health suffers.

events.title: Stray dog
events.text: A scruffy stray follows {{s.firstName}} home, tail wagging.

effects.tpl: Biscuit joins the family. Best decision ever.
Owner found, tears of joy. Karma +.

events.title: Magic trick gone wrong
events.text: {{s.firstName}} swallowed a coin. 'For magic,' they explain.

effects.tpl: All clear. The coin passes. The magic fizzles.

then.tpl: It passes naturally. Never speak of this.

else.tpl: Complications — a procedure. -$400, health -.

events.title: Wobbly tooth
events.text: A tooth hangs by a thread at dinner.

effects.tpl: SLAM. Tooth flies. Tooth fairy pays $5.
It falls into cereal. Fairy still pays $5.

events.title: Playground bully
events.text: A bigger kid keeps stealing {{s.firstName}}'s ball and calling names.

then.tpl: You face them down. They back off. Respect earned.

else.tpl: It ends in the dirt with a bloody nose. Lesson learned.

effects.tpl: Teacher intervenes. Bullying stops. Some kids call you snitch.
Three months of practice. Nobody steals your ball again.

events.title: Spelling bee finals
events.text: {{s.firstName}} made the school spelling bee finals. Word: 'serendipity'.

then.tpl: S-E-R-E-N-D-I-P-I-T-Y! Trophy + $200 prize!

else.tpl: You spell 'surrendipity'. The crowd groans kindly.

effects.tpl: Third place. Proud anyway.

events.title: Porch kitten
events.text: A tiny kitten appears on the porch during rain.

effects.tpl: Miso moves in and rules the house immediately.
Shelter donation $40. She finds a great home.

events.title: CRASH!
events.text: Baseball + neighbor's window = disaster. Mr. Henderson storms out.

effects.tpl: Mowing lawns all summer to pay $120. Character built.

then.tpl: Caught on doorbell cam! Parents pay $250. Grounded.

else.tpl: You escape. Guilt follows you for weeks.

events.title: Talent show
events.text: Sign-ups for the school talent show. {{s.firstName}} could perform.

then.tpl: Standing ovation! You're 'the talented kid' now.

else.tpl: Stage fright eats the second verse. Friends cheer anyway.

effects.tpl: Great show. Maybe next year.

events.title: Wallet on the sidewalk
events.text: A fat wallet on the sidewalk. $240 in cash, an ID, family photos.

effects.tpl: Owner cries, gives $20 reward. Karma soars.
New games! And a weird hollow feeling.

events.title: Chess club invite
events.text: The chess captain saw you thinking three moves ahead at lunch.

effects.tpl: Openings, endgames, trophies. Brain gains.
You pass. The captain never forgets.

events.title: Treehouse pact
events.text: Friends want to build a treehouse HQ all summer.

effects.tpl: Crooked, glorious, yours. HQ rules written in crayon.
They build it without you. You hear legends.

events.title: School plague
events.text: Half the class is out with flu. {{s.firstName}} feels scratchy.

effects.tpl: Three days of soup. Back stronger.

then.tpl: You tough it out. Perfect attendance!

else.tpl: Pneumonia. Two weeks in bed.

events.title: Art contest
events.text: City art contest: 'My Future'. Winner gets $500 and a gallery wall.

then.tpl: Your rocket-city wins! $500 + gallery wall!

else.tpl: Honorable mention. The practice helps.

effects.tpl: You admire the winners from the crowd.

events.title: Best friend moving
events.text: Your best friend's family is moving across the country. Last weekend together.

effects.tpl: Tears, bracelets, a promise to write. You keep it for years.
Best weekend ever. The goodbye still stings.

events.title: The game everyone plays
events.text: Everyone's obsessed with a new game. You beg for it for your birthday.

effects.tpl: Diamond rank! Grades wobble slightly.
Weekend fun, homework still done. Balance!
You read three novels while friends grind. Teachers notice.

events.title: Mud pies
events.text: A neighborhood kid dares {{s.firstName}} to eat a mud pie. $5 on the line.

effects.tpl: Gritty profit. $5 richer, slightly queasy.
You attempt a backflip. It is more of a backflop. Legend status anyway.

events.title: Lights in the sky
events.text: 3am. Humming. A beam. Classic abduction setup.

then.tpl: They probe your mind, upgrade it, return you by breakfast. Smarts +15!
Zoo trip: they show you Andromeda and drop you home.

else.tpl: Weird dreams and a missing Tuesday. Health -.

effects.tpl: Personal best sprint. The light fades.

events.title: Message from the future
events.text: An email from YOURSELF, dated 20 years ahead: 'Buy land. Be kind. Call mom.'

effects.tpl: You call mom. She cries happy. The land tip… wait and see.
Probably phishing. Probably.

events.title: Storm of the decade
events.text: Sirens wail. The sky turns green. A monster storm is coming.

effects.tpl: Batteries, water, blankets. The roof holds. $200 supplies.

then.tpl: Incredible photos! 50k likes!

else.tpl: Debris strike. Hospital + $5,000 damage.

events.title: Cold hands
events.text: A shivering person asks for change outside the store.

effects.tpl: Their smile warms you for days.
You avoid eye contact. It itches.

events.title: A bad flu season
events.text: A nasty flu sweeps the city. Schools debate closures. Grandma coughs ominously.

effects.tpl: Soup, thermometers, love. Everyone pulls through.
Boring. Healthy. Correct.

events.title: Invisible friend
events.text: {{s.firstName}} solemnly introduces Zorp, a nine-foot invisible dragon who lives in the pantry and eats socks.

effects.tpl: You set a plate for Zorp. The stories get wilder — and wonderful.
Zorp moves away. The house feels quieter. You feel awful.

events.title: Midnight thunder
events.text: A thunderstorm rattles the windows. {{s.firstName}} appears in the doorway, blanket in hand, eyes wide.

effects.tpl: Pillow walls, flashlight shadows. The storm becomes an adventure.
Just clouds bumping! Brave nod. Still sleeps on your floor.

events.title: Lost at the fair
events.text: Chasing a butterfly, {{s.firstName}} wanders off at the fair — and suddenly the crowd is all strangers.

effects.tpl: A vendor hears, holds your hand, pages the parents. Hugs for an hour.

then.tpl: You spot the balloon stand and retrace steps. Found!

else.tpl: An hour of terror ends at the lost-kids tent. Ice cream helps. -$100.

events.title: Storm-drain ducklings
events.text: {{s.firstName}} spots five ducklings peeping from a storm drain. Mama duck paces, frantic.

effects.tpl: Soggy, saved, paraded home in a shoebox. Heroes.
Officers arrive with nets. You supervise like a general.

events.title: First cavity
events.text: The dentist taps the X-ray: {{s.firstName}} has a first cavity. The drill gleams.

effects.tpl: Twenty minutes of buzzing. Sticker, pride, numb cheek.
The filling survives the sundae. Barely.

events.title: BLIZZARD!
events.text: School is cancelled! A foot of perfect snow waits outside for {{s.firstName}}.

effects.tpl: Seven runs, one epic wipeout, frozen toes, perfect day.
Three chapters and four marshmallows. Cozy genius.

events.title: The dare
events.text: {{s.firstName}} attempts the monkey bars backwards — because a dare is a dare.

then.tpl: Clean across! The playground erupts.

else.tpl: A snap, a cast, a $500 ER bill. The dare wins.

effects.tpl: You spot instead. The dare passes to someone louder.

events.title: Lemonade empire
events.text: {{s.firstName}} builds a lemonade stand: 50 cents a cup, hand-painted sign.

effects.tpl: Sold out by noon! ${{w}} profit and three regulars.
The whole block smiles. Profit: zero. Rich anyway.

events.title: Scary movie night
events.text: At a sleepover, the older kids put on a horror movie. {{s.firstName}} wants to go home but fears looking babyish.

effects.tpl: Home by ten. Teased Monday, slept great.

then.tpl: You survive AND get the jokes. Respect.

else.tpl: Nightmares for a week. The closet stays shut.

events.title: Allowance talks
events.text: Allowance: $5 a week for chores. {{s.firstName}} declares this oppression.

then.tpl: A calm pitch wins! $8 a week plus $30 back pay.

else.tpl: Denied — with extra chores. Negotiation is a skill. You are learning.

effects.tpl: Dishes gleam. Entrepreneurship simmers.

events.title: Report card day
events.text: Report card day. The teacher note reads: {{s.firstName}} has potential — the most dangerous sentence in school. Grades: {{s.education.grades}}.

effects.tpl: Homework charts, gold stars. The line goes up.
Everyone laughs, including the teacher. The grades do not.

events.title: First library card
events.text: {{s.firstName}} gets a first library card — and immediately loses a book ($12 fine).

effects.tpl: Fine paid. The librarian winks: it happens to everyone.
Dragons, astronauts, detectives. Ten books, zero fines since.

events.title: Travel team tryouts
events.text: Travel soccer tryouts. Twenty kids, eleven spots. {{s.firstName}} might make it — maybe.

then.tpl: Starting lineup! The jersey smells like victory.

else.tpl: Bench warmer with fire. Next season.

effects.tpl: Clipboard, whistle, everybody's friend. Power behind the throne.

events.title: Science fair
events.text: Science fair theme: The Future. {{s.firstName}} debates volcano (classic) vs robot arm (ambitious).

then.tpl: FIRST PLACE! $300 and a photo in the paper!

else.tpl: It moves! Just not on command. Honorable mention.

effects.tpl: Baking soda erupts on cue. The crowd roars. Classics endure.

events.title: Letter from afar
events.text: School pairs {{s.firstName}} with a pen pal across the ocean. The first letter arrives, covered in stamps.

effects.tpl: Letters fly monthly. Two worlds, one friendship.
The letters stop. You feel the silence.

events.title: Ant metropolis
events.text: An ant farm arrives. {{s.firstName}} names every tunnel.

effects.tpl: Highway, nursery, queen's chamber. Urban planning observed.
Back to the garden with honors. Freedom tastes like crumbs.

events.title: Bake sale arms race
events.text: The school bake sale rewards the top earner with a trophy.

effects.tpl: Ten trays gone by noon. You net 90 dollars and glory.
Your winnings fund the library corner. Trophy anyway.

events.title: Bee relocation
events.text: Bees swarm the mailbox. {{s.firstName}} refuses to let anyone spray.

effects.tpl: The beekeeper relocates the swarm. Mail saved, bees saved.
You learn waggle dances. The bees approve.

events.title: Ramp summer
events.text: Plywood, bricks, and a summer's worth of courage.

then.tpl: Air. Actual air. You land it and scream.

else.tpl: The ramp wins round one. Elbow vs gravel: gravel.

effects.tpl: Your jump-cut video gets the whole block famous.

events.title: Book fair week
events.text: The book fair arrives with that new-book smell and a wishlist.

effects.tpl: Three books chosen after deep deliberation. No regrets.
One for you, one for the class shelf. Reading spreads.

events.title: Camp letters
events.text: First week at sleepaway camp. Homesickness hits at lights-out.

effects.tpl: Letters full of canoe tales. Homesickness loses.
Bunk 6 becomes family. Capture the flag: won.

events.title: Backyard expedition
events.text: A tent, flashlights, and the wild backyard after dark.

effects.tpl: Owls, crickets, one suspicious raccoon. All logged.
The Sock Ghost tale becomes family canon.

events.title: Box prize heist
events.text: Two boxes, one prize. Sibling negotiations begin.

effects.tpl: You alternate days. Peace in our time.

then.tpl: Rock-paper-scissors champion. The whistle is yours.

else.tpl: Best of seven goes wrong. The whistle mocks you.

events.title: Rival rematch
events.text: The chess club rival wants a rematch. The trophy is a plastic knight.

then.tpl: Scholar's mate declined, then crushed. The knight is yours.

else.tpl: You lose in 20 moves but learn the Sicilian. Worth it.

effects.tpl: Five-minute games, all laughs. Rivalry becomes friendship.

events.title: Coin hunter
events.text: Grandpa's coin book has gaps. Flea markets have coins.

effects.tpl: A 1943 penny! Grandpa frames your find.
State quarters, complete. The book smells like victory.

events.title: Wishing well audit
events.text: The mall fountain holds a fortune in coins. You do the math.

effects.tpl: Estimated 340 dollars. You take zero. Character: built.
One coin, one wish: a bike. The fountain considers it.

events.title: Comic empire
events.text: Your hallway comic has ten readers and one very invested janitor.

effects.tpl: Thirty strips in. The janitor gets a character arc.
Fifty-cent copies. You earn 45 dollars and a fanbase.

events.title: Cushion canyon
events.text: Rain day: the couch becomes a canyon system.

effects.tpl: Blanket bridges span the canyon. Toys cross safely.
Reassembled without a trace. The couch never knew.

events.title: Little league shot
events.text: Tryouts Saturday. Your arm is decent, your nerves are not.

effects.tpl: You make the team. The glove gets a name.
You miss the cut but lead every chant. Still family.

events.title: Mystery agency
events.text: Lost cats, missing balls, a legendary lunchbox thief. You open cases.

effects.tpl: Cat found, ball returned, lunchbox: the dog did it. Closed.
You charge cookies only. The agency is beloved.

events.title: Junior dog show
events.text: The community dog show has a kid-handler class. Your dog is willing.

effects.tpl: Sit, stay, strut. Ribbon: blue. Dog: smug.
Hot-dog costume on a hot dog dog. Crowd favorite.

events.title: Firefly census
events.text: June nights blink. {{s.firstName}} starts counting fireflies.

effects.tpl: One jar, ten minutes, then freedom. The lawn glitters on.
The oak corner wins. Data collected, wonder intact.

events.title: Aquarium keeper
events.text: The class fish need summer care. You raise a hand.

effects.tpl: All seven survive. The fish know your face.
pH, ammonia, algae. You test like a scientist.

events.title: First catch
events.text: Dawn at the lake. The bobber twitches. This is the moment.

effects.tpl: A sunfish! Held high, photographed, released.
Every fish swims home. The lake remembers kindness.

events.title: Homemade fortunes
events.text: You bake fortune cookies with custom fortunes for the fair.

effects.tpl: You sell out. Best fortune: YOU WILL BUY ANOTHER.
Free cookies for the sad kids. Fortunes all come true.

events.title: Bracelet economy
events.text: Friendship bracelets are currency. You run the mint.

effects.tpl: Twenty bracelets, 30 dollars, infinite friendship.
Everyone weaves. The market crashes; joy soars.

events.title: Frog congress
events.text: The pond is loud with frogs and {{s.firstName}} holds a census.

effects.tpl: Forty-one frogs. One toad. Science served.
Frogs approve of the new real estate.

events.title: Garage band junior
events.text: Three kazoos and a drum. The garage has opinions.

effects.tpl: The Kazoo Kings play the block party. Encore demanded.
Lunch Lady Blues goes playground viral.

events.title: Hamster city
events.text: The class hamster spends the weekend with you and escapes by morning.

effects.tpl: Found in the laundry, living lavishly on a sock.
New tunnels installed. The hamster forgives you.

events.title: Hayride heroics
events.text: The haunted hayride needs kid volunteers to be the monsters.

effects.tpl: Your scarecrow gets its own fan club. Fear, but fun.
You walk the little ones through. Screams become giggles.

events.title: Great hole project
events.text: Three friends, four shovels, one hole to the center of the earth.

effects.tpl: Four feet deep. China is notified.
Bottle caps, a key, a mystery bone. Exhibits labeled.

events.title: First skate
events.text: Borrowed skates, wobbly ankles, the rink smells like cold joy.

effects.tpl: Eight lessons later: crossovers. The ice is yours.
You circle the rink holding the wall like family. Fun anyway.

events.title: Young inventors
events.text: The inventor fair accepts your automatic plant waterer.

effects.tpl: Second place! A real engineer wants your email.
The school greenhouse adopts it. Plants rejoice.

events.title: Double dutch trials
events.text: The double dutch crew needs a fourth jumper. The ropes blur.

then.tpl: In, turning, rhyming. The crew adopts you.

else.tpl: Rope burn and laughter. Round two tomorrow.

effects.tpl: Best turner on the block. Jumpers beg for your wrists.

events.title: Kite festival
events.text: The lake kite festival: dragons, boxes, and one fighter kite.

effects.tpl: Thirty feet of dragon over the lake. Applause from boats.
You fix six kites. The sky fills because of you.

events.title: Lemonade empire
events.text: Saturday lemonade stand faces a rival stand across the street.

effects.tpl: Fifty-cent cups flood the market. You count 120 dollars of profit.
Mint and honey. Fancy cups. The rivals defect to you.

events.title: Tooth fairy audit
events.text: The tooth fairy leaves a note: INFLATION. {{s.firstName}} demands answers.

effects.tpl: A tiny letter explains fairy economics. Accepted.
Twenty dollars under the pillow. The fairy pays up.

events.title: Birthday magician
events.text: Your cousin's party needs entertainment. You own a cape.

effects.tpl: Cards, coins, a vanished grape. The kids lose it.
Best volunteered-from-audience ever. Suspicion: zero.

events.title: Marble season
events.text: Marble season: keepers rules, and your shooter is chipped.

then.tpl: You win the galaxy marble. Displayed, never played.

else.tpl: Lost the shooter. A hard lesson in a circle of dirt.

effects.tpl: Bank shots, spins, applause from the fence.

events.title: Backyard cinema
events.text: A sheet, a projector, and the whole street invited.

effects.tpl: Forty kids, one classic, popcorn math perfected.
Your pick lands. The street quotes it for weeks.

events.title: Mud bakery
events.text: The garden becomes a bakery. Mud cupcakes, grass frosting, rock sprinkles.

effects.tpl: Full menu served to very patient worms.
You bake only in the dirt patch. Garden saved, fun kept.

events.title: Locker mystery
events.text: Something in the locker row smells. Science demands investigation.

effects.tpl: A September banana. Case closed. Noses saved.
You organize the clean-out. The row breathes again.

events.title: New kid protocol
events.text: A new kid stands alone at lunch with a tray and nowhere to sit.

effects.tpl: One wave later, the table has a new regular.
You show them every shortcut. Friendship speedrun.

events.title: Flashlight tag
events.text: Summer nights mean flashlight tag across three yards.

effects.tpl: You tag all seven. The flashlight never lies.
Inside the bush fort. Unfound for an hour. Legend.

events.title: Orchard ladder duty
events.text: Harvest day: someone light must climb for the top apples.

effects.tpl: Two bushels of high apples. Pie season secured.
Perfect stacks, zero bruises. The market stand thrives.

events.title: Pit orchestra
events.text: The school musical needs a kid for the pit. You own an instrument. Sort of.

effects.tpl: Second chair. The overture gives you chills.
Spotlight operator. You ARE the drama now.

events.title: Owl pellet lab
events.text: Science class dissects owl pellets. Bones included.

effects.tpl: Full skeleton assembled. Nature is metal. A+ earned.
Your labeled drawings go on the classroom wall.

events.title: Paper plane league
events.text: Lunch recess hosts the unauthorized paper plane championship.

effects.tpl: Your dart flies the full yard. Legend status.
Loops! Applause! It lands in the soup. Worth it.

events.title: Paper route Jr.
events.text: A morning route opens. 5am, bike, 40 houses.

effects.tpl: Six months of dawns. You save 140 dollars and gain grit.
Half route each. Papers fly, friendship holds.

events.title: Overseas pen pal
events.text: A pen pal from France writes about cheese and school strikes.

effects.tpl: Your letters cross oceans. French swear words learned.
Peanut butter diplomacy. Alliance secured.

events.title: Attendance streak
events.text: 160 days, zero absences. Chickenpox season approaches.

then.tpl: 180 days! Certificate, assembly applause, iron immune system.

else.tpl: Day 171: the flu wins. The streak dies a hero.

effects.tpl: You stay home, heal fast, and live to streak again.

events.title: Pizza Friday coup
events.text: {{s.firstName}} campaigns to make pizza every Friday. Forever.

effects.tpl: Pizza Fridays ratified. Democracy delicious.
Homemade dough, veggie faces, pride edible.

events.title: Playground mayor
events.text: Someone must organize the four-square ladder. It might as well be you.

effects.tpl: Rankings posted daily. Disputes: zero. Legacy: secured.
Four-square with a bonus box. Chaos, then brilliance.

events.title: Pogo record
events.text: Your pogo best is 200 jumps. The block record is 500.

then.tpl: 512 jumps! Record smashed. Legs: legendary.

else.tpl: 340 jumps. The record survives. Next summer, it falls.

effects.tpl: Three new jumpers join. The pogo club is born.

events.title: Pond skate day
events.text: The pond freezes thick enough. The whole street laces up.

effects.tpl: Third place, first in style points. Cocoa after.
You teach stops and starts. The pond gains a skater.

events.title: Puddle games
events.text: Post-storm: biggest splash, longest jump, best cannonball.

effects.tpl: Splash gold. Socks: sacrificed. Glory: eternal.
Your scoring is beyond reproach. Athletes weep with joy.

events.title: Great pumpkin bet
events.text: Your pumpkin rivals Old Man Haro's. Weigh-in is Halloween.

then.tpl: 98 pounds! Prize pumpkin, 150 dollars, one wheelbarrow.

else.tpl: 61 pounds. Haro wins again. Next year, compost.

effects.tpl: A three-face mega-lantern. The street stops to stare.

events.title: Puppet hour
events.text: The library puppet show needs a kid dragon. You fit the costume.

effects.tpl: Toddlers scream with joy. The dragon takes a bow.
Invisible, essential. The show runs on your ropes.

events.title: Reading fort Friday
events.text: Rain cancels practice. The library runs a fort-building reading hour.

effects.tpl: Blanket fort, flashlight, three chapters. Best rainy day ever.
You read to a first-grader. They follow you like a hero.

events.title: Rain barrel project
events.text: The community garden needs rain barrels. You volunteer the crew.

effects.tpl: Two barrels plumbed. The tomatoes thank you.
Rain clouds and suns. The barrels are art now.

events.title: Rainy museum day
events.text: Rain cancels the game. The museum beckons, dinosaur wing first.

effects.tpl: You can now name fourteen sauropods. Power.
One crystal, chosen after an hour. Worth it.

events.title: Bottle empire
events.text: Cans are worth a nickel each and the block throws away fortunes.

effects.tpl: You haul, sort, and cash 85 dollars. Green and rich.
Half the haul buys park flowers. The block glows.

events.title: Robot kit birthday
events.text: A robot kit arrives with 200 parts and instructions in three languages.

effects.tpl: It walks! It beeps! It fears stairs. Brilliant.
Five kids, one robot, zero leftover screws. Teamwork.

events.title: Rock fortune
events.text: A rock tumbler promises gems. The grit takes weeks.

effects.tpl: Shiny agates sold for 60 dollars. Patience pays.
Every friend gets a gem. You are rich in gratitude.

events.title: Backyard society
events.text: Four kids, one clubhouse, a password that changes hourly.

effects.tpl: Membership triples. The password is now a state secret.
Everyone joins. The clubhouse needs a bigger blanket.

events.title: Family recipe heist
events.text: Grandma's cookie recipe is locked in memory. You want it written down.

effects.tpl: Three weekends of pinch-of-this. Recipe secured forever.
Filmed, captioned, backed up. Grandma goes viral at church.

events.title: Chalk gallery
events.text: The whole driveway is canvas. The neighbors slow down to look.

effects.tpl: A dragon spans the driveway. Cars detour respectfully.
The perfect hopscotch. Jump-tested by twelve kids.

events.title: Rock stand
events.text: Painted rocks sell surprisingly well to neighbors.

effects.tpl: Ladybugs, monters, galaxies. You bank 65 dollars.
Kindness rocks hidden in the park. Strangers smile.

events.title: Sled Olympics
events.text: The hill hosts luge, slalom, and style events. Snow pants required.

effects.tpl: Silver in slalom, gold in style. The hill remembers.
Your jump adds two feet of glory. Medics on standby.

events.title: Midnight ghost tour
events.text: Sleepover dare: the basement at midnight, flashlights only.

then.tpl: You narrate the furnace like a pro. Legends are born.

else.tpl: A coat on a hook ends the tour early. Screams, then giggles.

effects.tpl: You hold base camp. Returning heroes need popcorn.

events.title: Snow fort wars
events.text: The big snow brings the annual fort war against Maple Street.

effects.tpl: Walls hold. Snowballs fly. Victory is cold and sweet.
Treaty over cocoa. Both forts become one castle.

events.title: Shovel crew
events.text: The blizzard buries driveways. Cash waits under the snow.

effects.tpl: Six driveways, 110 dollars, arms like iron.
Hydrants dug out free. Firefighters wave. Heroes.

events.title: Spelling redemption
events.text: Last year's on-stage freeze still burns. This year's bee is here.

effects.tpl: You spell ANTEDILUVIAN without blinking. Redemption.
You go out round three but your definitions slay.

events.title: Word safari
events.text: The teacher hides vocabulary cards around the school like treasure.

effects.tpl: Every card found. Vocabulary: conquered.
You split the map. Both teams win the hunt.

events.title: Roof observatory
events.text: Blankets on the garage roof, meteor shower at midnight.

effects.tpl: Sixty-two meteors. Three wishes used wisely.
Orion, Cassiopeia, and your own invented hero.

events.title: Transit expedition
events.text: Dad lets you navigate the whole transit map alone together.

effects.tpl: Three transfers, zero panic. Navigator certified.
A saxophonist teaches you a scale. The ride sings.

events.title: Recorder recital
events.text: The school concert features your recorder solo. The bar is low, the stakes feel high.

effects.tpl: Hot Cross Buns, flawless. Grandma weeps.
You miss a note but the spin saves the show.

events.title: Yo-yo trials
events.text: The talent show needs an act. Your sleeper lasts 40 seconds.

effects.tpl: Walk the dog, rock the baby, standing ovation.
Synced yo-yos with your best friend. Twice the glory.

events.title: Tire swing summit
events.text: The tire swing fits three. Four kids want it. Summit called.

effects.tpl: Two-minute rotations. Peace spins on.
You push all afternoon. Arms of steel, heart of gold.

events.title: The big oak ban
events.text: The park bans climbing the old oak after the branch incident.

effects.tpl: You climb only approved trees. Ranger respect earned.
Forty signatures. Climbing hours: weekends. Democracy.

events.title: Kite retrieval op
events.text: Your best friend's kite is stuck in the old oak. A crowd gathers.

then.tpl: Up and down like a squirrel. Kite saved, hero made.

else.tpl: Branch one: fine. Branch two: gravity lesson.

effects.tpl: Two rakes taped together. Engineering beats altitude.

events.title: Treehouse toll
events.text: The treehouse crew demands a toll: one snack per entry.

effects.tpl: Apple tolls accepted. The crew respects a giver.
The ground fort undercuts them. Merger talks begin.

events.title: Tutor flip
events.text: You are great at math. A struggling star athlete needs help.

effects.tpl: Fractions for free throws. Both grades and game improve.
